lexicalDecisions.decision: Reuse exact 冗談じょうだん, existing N3 word metadata and examples preserved. 戯談 and 串戯 are search-only spellings, not ordinary alternate practice examples. One reading, one practical existing support: no necessary new word article.

Core 冗 is superfluous/useless; 冗長じょうちょう supplies a short unlinked recognition contrast for wordy/long-winded, and 冗長性じょうちょうせい recognizes technical redundancy. Technical redundancy need not be a fault. Do not equate every compound with a joke or make the standalone 冗 noun the everyday practice model.

Preserve complete aliases and local flags: 冗員/剰員 and especially冗員's useless-staff sense; 剰語 has a rare-spelling flag; にょうぜつ is outdated kana usage, not proof that ordinaryじょうぜつ is obsolete; 冗口 is search-only within 無駄口. None is needed for additional practice.
冗談に紛らす is explicitly rare; 音楽の冗談 is a named work. Neither is ordinary-support frequency evidence or a reason to expand this batch.

Do not infer universal rarity from missing priorities, teach technical redundancy as inherently useless, literalize 冗談じゃない across contexts, or add unneeded articles.
